02 — Spectral Power (Welch PSD)

Chapter 2 · Univariate spectral biomarkers of anhedonia during positive music.

🔬 Hypothesis

MDD shows reduced high-frequency power to positive music — anhedonia biomarker. Expected pattern: Controls have higher power in the target band during positive music; tones show little group difference.
Music has rich spectral structure. We predict controls show elevated high-frequency power and stronger auditory–limbic coherence during positive music. MDD (anhedonia) exhibits blunted responses.

💡 Key Insight

MDD shows reduced high-frequency power to positive music. | Effect: ~1.3× higher band power in Controls (music) Evidence: Dissociation is stimulus-specific (little group difference on tones).
